actions.item: Unicode bidirectional CSV spoofing resistance in irrigation water planning tool
actions.before: Crop labels allowed invisible bidi override and Unicode paragraph separators in export
actions.change: Blocked bidi spoofing controls and invisible line separators while preserving legitimate Persian ZWNJ
actions.after: Water budget CSV labels are safer; 19 calculator tests plus 13 subtests passed in CI

actions.item: Explicit contribution and operating profit percent metrics in farm enterprise calculator
actions.before: User could see cash values but not distinct relative contribution and operating profitability ratios
actions.change: Added decimal-safe two margin percentages with zero-revenue null and loss-making negative cases
actions.after: Economic planning output now distinguishes variable contribution from after-fixed-cost operating margin; tests passed
